review: [anaya · done] Checked TERMS, GUARDRAILS, SKELETON, JURY-QA and SYNTHESIS s6 against CALL-02 and my anaya.md s3-4. Hero = field objects with triage kept (no flag); S* = same seed, fault off, culprit stops from its suspension tick; F2+x and F2+c present; baselines oracle-assisted; c_culprit_window present; revised D13 meaning is carried as six elements with no pasteable sentence, so Aarav words it himself. No new outside numbers, so FACT-CARD still holds. Greps for flagged / triage / suspect / restore epoch / bare post_alert_tainted show no contradictions: every hit is either the kept-triage rule, the F2+x conflict case, an honest 'suspect = root_candidates[0], console only', or a changelog line. Nits, none blocking: (1) TERMS s7 item 6 says ADR-06 still has the old metric names, but ADR-06-metrics.md now uses the new ones, so drop that note. (2) Collateral stall key: ADR-06-metrics s2 defines 'stall' only as prose, not a score.json key. Name it collateral_stall, shaped {n,d} like R and C, and keep it apart from fp_cost.stall_ticks (honest-suspension ticks). Its formula S0_T vs S*_T compares the two oracles and so measures the culprit mirror, not stall imposed on honest work. It should compare the system run's final_T against the unmirrored S0 for non-culprit keys, as CALL-02 anaya.md s2.1 says. tara to fix in ADR-06, then TERMS s7 item 10 copies the key. how-it-works 3c is untouched, as scoped.
